zh.explain: 对着风点蜡烛当然点不燃，即使点燃了，烛光疏影，如同镜中的恍惚之花。儿童看了几度要来收拾，但这一切只是收获虚名幻影而已。
divination: 富贵由天注定，贫穷为命中带来，不需要尽心费力地去追求谋划，
一切都是前世已经确定了的。
zh.summary: 此卦当风点烛之象。所祈求之事如果是为了贪图虚名，则不吉利。

verse: Fleeting shadows cast by a candle in the wind,
Reflect in the mirror like a bed of many flowers.
Mystified, the child wants to keep the flowers,
Only to find that these are only virtual and unreal.
interpretation: It is predestined how wealth is distributed and Who will be poor.
Since it’s already decided, it is pointless to seek anything.
meaning: As a lighted candle flickers in the wind, it is not good to aim for an empty title.
en.explain: It is not possible to light a candle in the wind. Even if one manages to do so, the candle flame will only cast fleeting shadows, like vague reflections of flowers in a mirror. Children would look at it several times and want to pick it up, but this is all an illusion.
divination: Wealth is predestined by Heaven. Poverty is brought about by one's fate. There is no need to waste your effort in pursuing and scheming. Everything has been determined by your past lives.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings.
Migrating and moving house:  Maintain status quo
Do sincere repentance to clear obstacles

notes: EN items: image prints one merged line 'Change:  Migrating and moving house:  Maintain status quo' (Change has no value of its own); kept literally as a single Change pair, so EN has 17 items vs zh 18 (zh 转换变更 = 不变为上).
